name: worktree-panel
description: Panel web local para trabajar tareas de Jira con Claude Code, cada una en su git worktree

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm run start:server
